headline_seed: Hero pilot who fought off hijack attempt prevented ‘disaster for Israel,’ Netanyahu tells CNN - CNN
draft_text:
A pilot on Flydubai flight FZ1073 stabbed the captain mid-flight; the plane dropped 17,000 feet before an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, BBC News reports. Capt. Smit Machchhar, hailed a hero, was hospitalized in stable condition. 174 lives on board.

And that's the mews.
